title: claude-config's factory half moves into factory/ with its history, traced item by item

story.i_want_to: find every factory hook, skill, script and the delivery-loop prose in the loopctl repo, each with a recorded fate and what it reads
story.so_that: a factory change is built and reviewed in one repo instead of handed between loopctl and claude-config

rationale: PRD R10: the factory's claude-config half (the channel and claim gates, review-round-counter, gate-stated-intent, the delivery-loop gates, the handoff/shepherd/fleet/triage-trio/agent-spec-builder skills, five bin scripts, the nudger and the delivery-loop section of CLAUDE.md) lives in /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config, so loopctl#1065 shipped green in loopctl and broke against gate-channel-claim-scope.sh (loopctl#1067). PRD section 9 leaves 'which hooks are factory-only' to this release, settled by tracing what each reads. This story records that trace as a checked inventory and imports the surviving files with history; the items R2, R3 and R11 replaced are not imported.

acceptance_criteria.description: factory/inventory.toml has one [[item]] per file of the factory half and of its hooks/lib closure, each with origin (its claude-config path, or new for a file this story writes), fate (one of pack, generated, thin_call, retired) and reads (a non-empty list from: transcript, command_text, tool_input, git, gh, loopctl:<route>, local_file:<path>).

mix factory.inventory --check exits 0 only when every file under factory/src is an inventory item whose fate is not retired and every non-retired item's file exists under factory/src; otherwise it exits 1 naming each unmatched path.

Every non-retired item whose origin is a claude-config path is imported with its claude-config history: git log --follow on factory/src/hooks/gate-stated-intent.sh lists the claude-config commits that touched hooks/gate-stated-intent.sh.

Items deleted from claude-config before this release are inventory items with fate retired, a replaced_by naming the release-3, 4 or 7 mechanism, and no file under factory/src: bin/session-message.sh and hooks/channel-push-on-prompt.sh (deleted by US-52.28), and skills/handoff, bin/handoff-issue.sh, gate-claimed-handoff.sh, warn-claimed-handoff.sh, block-handoff-placeholder.sh and gate-channel-claim-scope.sh (deleted by the claude-config PR US-52.49 merges before the release-7 deploy), plus block-channel-scope-bypass.sh, gate-claimed-dispatch.sh, gate-channel-naming.sh, lib/claims.sh and lib/handoff-anchor.sh. hooks/lib/review-cap.sh, hooks/gate-redesign-dispatch.sh and hooks/tests/review-cap-pause-canary.sh (the REVIEW CAP pause, deleted from claude-config on 2026-11-19) are retired the same way, with replaced_by the release-8 review-round ceiling, at which the session decides whether to dispatch a redesign or narrow what merges.
factory/src/bin/fleet-nudge.sh is imported as US-52.28 left it, a sweep of the machine it runs on: the fleet-nudge canary fails when the imported file contains an ssh invocation.

The delivery-loop section of claude-config CLAUDE.md (lines 44-61) is imported as factory/src/prose/delivery-loop.md.eex with every ~/workspace/claude-config/bin/ path rewritten to ~/.claude/factory/bin/ (the imported text carries no REVIEW CAP message and no 'Mark chose redesign' line), and the 'Reach a session on another machine' bullet is imported beside it as US-52.28 rewrote it (message_send and the inbox), unchanged.

factory/src/skills/move/SKILL.md (origin new, fate pack) describes handing work on as work_item_move plus work-item notes and the inbox, and names no channel_claim, channel_done, handoff tool or handoff: key; skills/handoff is not imported.

The imported hooks' canaries run in CI: a factory-src job on [self-hosted, fleet-ci] runs bash -n and shellcheck on factory/src/**/*.sh and every factory/src/hooks/tests/*-canary.sh, and fails on the first non-zero exit.

test_cases.name: inventory check: a stray file and a missing file are both named (unit, ExUnit on Mix.Tasks.Factory.Inventory)
preconditions: a tmp dir holding an inventory with two pack items and factory/src holding one of them plus an unlisted file
expected_results: exit 1; output names the unlisted file and the missing item's path

test_cases.name: inventory schema: an item with an unknown fate or an empty reads list is refused (unit)
preconditions: inventory items with fate: "moved" and with reads: []

test_cases.name: history preserved (integration, git in the checkout)
preconditions: the epic branch with the import merged
expected_results: the log lists the claude-config commits that touched hooks/gate-stated-intent.sh

test_cases.name: retired items have no file and carry replaced_by (unit over the committed inventory)
steps: select items with fate retired; check each has replaced_by and no file under factory/src
expected_results: every item with fate retired has a replaced_by naming the release-3, 4, 7 or 8 mechanism
no retired item has a file under factory/src

test_cases.name: the imported fleet-nudge has no ssh arm (canary)
steps: bash factory/src/hooks/tests/fleet-nudge-local-canary.sh against the imported file, then against a fixture copy with an ssh line added
expected_results: exit 0, then exit 1 naming the ssh line

test_cases.name: imported prose and move skill name no retired path or tool (unit, grep in ExUnit)
steps: scan for workspace/claude-config/bin, session-message.sh, channel_claim, channel_done, handoff:, REVIEW CAP, Mark chose redesign

test_cases.name: the factory-src CI job fails on a broken canary (integration, workflow on a throwaway branch)
preconditions: a branch where one canary exits 1
steps: push; read the factory-src job result
expected_results: factory-src job failed, naming the canary

technical_notes: Trace (settles PRD section 9, 'which claude-config hooks are factory-only', read 2026-11-19). thin_call (decision needs a server fact): plugins/review-round-counter (local plugin store, hooks.ts:2542,2620; becomes US-52.53). generated (local judgement over command text or transcript, rule values from policy): gate-stated-intent.sh (transcript; lib/stop-judge.sh, loop-mode.sh, headless.sh), gate-pr-body.sh (command_text, gh, git; lib/cmd-scan.sh, refusal-note.sh, effective-dir.sh), gate-unmerged-pr.sh (transcript, gh; lib/check-runs.sh, loop-mode.sh), gate-epic-merge-green-base.sh (command_text, gh), block-loop-mode-merge.sh (command_text; lib/merge-scan.sh), block-catchup-merge.sh (command_text, git), block-manual-precommit.sh (command_text; lib/mix-scan.sh, scrub.sh), require-gate-lock.sh (command_text, local_file:.claude/gate.lock; lib/gate-lock-fd.sh), inject-review-context.sh (tool_input; bin/review-context.py, review-bundle.py), inject-fix-contract.sh (local_file:commands/review/fix-review-findings.md), brief-dispatch.py (tool_input; docs/harness/dispatch.md), keep-orchestrator-working.sh (loopctl, transcript).

pack (moved as is): skills/shepherd, skills/agent-spec-builder, commands/fleet.md, commands/triage-trio.md, agents/triage-analyst.md, triage-architect.md, triage-engineer.md, bin/wait-for-checks.sh (lib/check-runs.sh), bin/delete-merged-branch.sh, bin/worktree-remove.sh (lib/worktree-partition.sh), bin/fleet-nudge.sh and bin/fleet-orchestrator.sh (lib/session-triage.sh, fleet-name.sh, mark-pause.sh). All paths under /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config; line counts are not recorded (doc hygiene).

retired, replaced_by: channel and claim gates (gate-channel-claim-scope.sh:1-30, block-channel-scope-bypass.sh, gate-claimed-handoff.sh, warn-claimed-handoff.sh, gate-claimed-dispatch.sh, lib/claims.sh) -> the story claim refused to a second holder (release 3, README names table: the claim's holder); the handoff skill and guards (skills/handoff, block-handoff-placeholder.sh, lib/handoff-anchor.sh, bin/handoff-issue.sh) -> the move verb (release 7); gate-channel-naming.sh -> one project per repo on the server (US-52.1); channel-push-on-prompt.sh and bin/session-message.sh -> inbox and message_send (release 4); the REVIEW CAP pause (hooks/lib/review-cap.sh, hooks/gate-redesign-dispatch.sh, hooks/tests/review-cap-pause-canary.sh) -> the release-8 ceiling at which the session decides (PRD R2). The claude-config PR of 2026-11-19 that deleted the pause also removed its branches from gate-stated-intent.sh, gate-unmerged-pr.sh, keep-orchestrator-working.sh, gate-drip-feed.sh and bin/fleet-nudge.sh and moved the transcript definitions into hooks/lib/mark-pause.sh, so those files are imported as that PR left them. The items US-52.28 and US-52.49's claude-config PR deleted have no origin file left at import; their inventory rows record the trace only.

Not factory (stay in claude-config, recorded nowhere here): block-subagent-git.sh and plugins/agent-git-grant (the Subagents rule binds every dispatch, not only delivery), gate-drip-feed.sh (SOUL rule 0), block-complex-bash.sh and the other general hygiene hooks. The lib closure above moves to the pack, which owns it; US-52.54 points claude-config's remaining users at it.

Import mechanics follow release 2's import of runner/ and chg/ (README names table): git filter-repo --paths-from-file on a clone of claude-config, --path-rename to factory/src/, then git merge --allow-unrelated-histories onto the epic branch. Retired files are excluded from the path list, so their history stays in claude-config only.

The delivery-loop section is /home/mkreyman/workspace/claude-config/CLAUDE.md:44-61; the 'Reach a session' bullet is :31. The .eex suffix is there for US-52.52, which renders policy values into it; this story imports the text unchanged except the path and bullet rewrites.

Loopctl.Factory.Inventory (lib/loopctl/factory/inventory.ex) parses TOML with the parser release 2 brings in to read release/manifest.toml (README names table: release manifest); mix.lock has no TOML library today. The mix task is lib/mix/tasks/factory.inventory.ex. Tests are unit (no DB), async: true.
CI: add the factory-src job to .github/workflows/ci.yml beside lint (:134), runs-on [self-hosted, fleet-ci] like every Elixir job there; it is not added to the deploy job's needs.
non_goals: Generating hooks and prose from policy and building the installable pack: US-52.52.
Rewriting review-round-counter as a thin call: US-52.53.
Deleting the moved and retired files from claude-config: US-52.54.
Moving the inbox hooks (hooks/inbox-on-tool.sh and the INBOX block of hooks/session-start.sh, both US-52.28): US-52.54.

failure_modes.partition: n/a: a one-time import and a static check over files in the checkout; nothing crosses a network at run time.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.50.1: which files are factory and what each reads is recorded once, in factory/inventory.toml under version control, and AC-52.50.2 keeps it equal to the tree.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.50.2: the check is a pure read of the tree, so re-running it changes nothing; the import is one merge commit, and a second merge of the same filtered history is a no-op in git.
failure_modes.slow: n/a: no network call in the check; the CI job is bounded by the job timeout of ci.yml like every other job.
failure_modes.reach: AC-52.50.8: the canaries run in the factory-src CI job on the fleet-ci pool, where every other ci.yml job runs.

defaults: Import root: factory/src (hooks/, hooks/lib/, hooks/tests/, bin/, skills/, commands/, agents/, prose/); the built pack is factory/pack (US-52.52).
block-subagent-git.sh, agent-git-grant and gate-drip-feed.sh stay in claude-config as general rules (owner may move them).
fleet-nudge is imported as a local sweep; US-52.28 retired its ssh fan-out in release 4.
definition_of_done: mix factory.inventory --check exits 0 on the epic branch.
git log --follow factory/src/bin/wait-for-checks.sh shows the claude-config commit history of bin/wait-for-checks.sh.
